$comment: Commands of the web UI's Terminal page. The builder (GenerateTerminalFiles) generates web/generated/terminal-commands.ts (completion, help, tooltip: compiled into the web app) and generated/terminal_commands.hh (the firmware needs a handler for every command that is not 'client' and an answer for every lookup, checked at compile time). A parameter's values are either listed ('values': strings or {value, doc}), fetched live from the device ('lookup': a name from 'lookups', answered by src/terminal.cpp), computed in the browser ('source': commands | registers), or free (only 'doc').

lookups.name: inputs
lookups.doc: digital inputs of this hardware revision with their levels

lookups.name: outputs
lookups.doc: switchable outputs of this hardware revision with their states

lookups.name: pins
lookups.doc: all GPIO pins of the package with their levels

commands.name: help
commands.doc: list the commands, or show the parameters of one command

commands.name: info
commands.doc: host name, hardware revision, firmware, uptime, Ethernet

commands.name: out
commands.doc: outputs (valves, vacuum, stepper enable): list or switch

params.name: output
params.doc: output to switch; without: list all

commands.name: gpio
commands.doc: read any pin, or drive an output pin

params.name: level
params.doc: drive the pin (an output of the I/O cycle is overwritten within 50 ms)

commands.name: i2c
commands.doc: scan an I2C bus for devices

commands.name: reg
commands.doc: read a register, or write a holding register

params.name: address
params.doc: register address (type a name to search)

commands.name: stepper
commands.doc: enable the steppers and move one to a position
